Triangulate a survival question across methods

Source: R/triangulate.R
survkit_triangulate.Rd

Fit the same data under several methods and compare them on the restricted mean survival time (and, if a landmark time is given, on survival at that time). The relative spread across methods is a model-misspecification signal: when the methods disagree by more than threshold, the fit is flagged.

Usage

survkit_triangulate(
  formula,
  data,
  methods = c("weibull", "cox", "km"),
  tau = NULL,
  time_star = NULL,
  newdata = NULL,
  threshold = 0.1,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

A model formula with a survival::Surv() response.

data

A data frame.

methods

Character vector of registry keys to compare (default c("weibull", "cox", "km")). Methods whose backend is missing, or that fail to fit, are dropped with a warning.

tau

Numeric horizon for the restricted mean. The default is the 90th percentile of the observed times.

time_star

Optional landmark time; when given, survival at time_star is compared as well.

newdata

Optional single covariate profile for the model-based quantities.

threshold

Numeric relative-spread threshold above which the methods are flagged as disagreeing (default 0.1, i.e. 10 percent).

...

Passed to each survkit() fit.

Value

A survkit_triangulation list with the per-method quantities, the disagreement summary, and a logical flagged. It has a print method.

See also

survkit_rmst() for the quantity compared, survkit() for a single fit.

Other model-fitting: is_survkit_refusal(), survkit(), survkit_cuminc(), survkit_power(), survkit_refusal(), survkit_rmst(), survkit_score()

Examples

tri <- survkit_triangulate(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex,
                           survival::lung, methods = c("weibull", "cox", "km"),
                           tau = 500)
tri
#> $methods
#> [1] "weibull" "cox"     "km"     
#> 
#> $tau
#> [1] 500
#> 
#> $time_star
#> NULL
#> 
#> $rmst
#>    method tau     rmst
#> 1 weibull 500 311.5567
#> 2     cox 500 312.7260
#> 3      km 500 310.3344
#> 
#> $survival
#> NULL
#> 
#> $disagreement
#>   quantity  spread    relative flagged
#> 1     rmst 2.39158 0.007676662   FALSE
#> 
#> $flagged
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $threshold
#> [1] 0.1
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "survkit_triangulation"
